name: fattureincloud
description: Manage your FattureInCloud account from Claude: invoices, e-invoicing (SDI), clients, cost / revenue centers, and supplier documents.
long_description: FattureInCloud is the leading Italian SaaS for electronic invoicing. Italy mandates B2B/B2C e-invoicing through the Sistema di Interscambio (SDI) — this community-built MCP server brings AI-assisted billing to that compliance-driven workflow. Read and write operations are supported across invoices, credit notes, proformas, received documents, clients, and cost / revenue centers, plus a yearly financial dashboard. API calls go directly from the user's machine to FattureInCloud's API; no data is routed through third-party servers. This is an unofficial integration. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by TeamSystem S.p.A., owner of the FattureInCloud trademark.

api_token.title: FattureInCloud API Token
api_token.description: Personal API access token. Get it from FattureInCloud → Settings → API and Integrations → Manual Token. Starts with 'a/'.

company_id.title: FattureInCloud Company ID
company_id.description: Numeric company ID. Visible in the FattureInCloud URL after /c/ once you have selected the company.

sender_email.title: Sender Email (optional)
sender_email.description: Mailbox used as sender by the send_email tool when sending courtesy copies of invoices. Leave empty if you don't plan to use send_email.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List issued documents (invoices / credit notes / proformas) for a year, with optional month, type, and free-text query filters.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Get full detail of a single document by ID (invoice, credit note, or proforma).

tools.name: get_pdf_url
tools.description: Return the PDF URL and the FattureInCloud web link for a document.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: List clients with optional name / VAT filter.

tools.name: get_client
tools.description: Get full client registry detail by ID: address, PEC, phone, SDI code.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get info about the connected FattureInCloud company.

tools.name: create_client
tools.description: Create a new client in the registry.

tools.name: update_client
tools.description: Update an existing client. Only the fields passed are modified.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a draft invoice with automatic SDI code lookup. Optional revenue_center.

tools.name: create_credit_note
tools.description: Create a draft credit note. Positive amounts in input, negated automatically. Optional revenue_center.

tools.name: create_proforma
tools.description: Create a draft proforma (cannot be sent to SDI). Optional revenue_center.

tools.name: convert_proforma_to_invoice
tools.description: Convert a proforma into a draft electronic invoice. By default the source proforma is deleted (set keep_proforma=true to retain it).

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Partial update of a draft document (invoice / credit note / proforma). Only fields passed are changed. Fails if the document was already sent to SDI.

tools.name: duplicate_invoice
tools.description: Duplicate an invoice with a new date, optional payment-days override, and optional description text replacements.

tools.name: delete_invoice
tools.description: Delete a draft document. Irreversible.

tools.name: send_to_sdi
tools.description: Send an invoice or credit note to the Italian Sistema di Interscambio (SDI). Irreversible.

tools.name: get_invoice_status
tools.description: Read the e-invoice / SDI status of a document.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a courtesy copy of a document by email. Requires the FIC_SENDER_EMAIL env var.

tools.name: list_received_documents
tools.description: List received (supplier) documents — expenses or received credit notes — for a year, with optional month and free-text query.

tools.name: get_situation
tools.description: Yearly financial dashboard: net revenue (invoices minus credit notes), collected, outstanding, costs, margin. Optional client filter.

tools.name: check_numeration
tools.description: Verify invoice numbering continuity for a given year. Reports gaps.

tools.name: list_cost_centers
tools.description: List configured cost AND revenue centers (deduplicated union of the two FIC API endpoints, matching the 'Analisi centri c/r' view in FattureInCloud's UI). Validation on issued document mutations matches the input against revenue_centers only; validation on received document mutations matches against cost_centers only.

tools.name: get_received_document
tools.description: Get full detail of a single received document by ID.

tools.name: create_received_document
tools.description: Create a received document (expense or received credit note) with supplier, amounts, optional category and description, and optional cost_center.
